aligned_sharp_policy.rn1_event: last sharp poll strictly before RN1 fill
aligned_sharp_policy.sharp_pm_gap: aligned sharp HOME probability minus M4 PM baseline HOME execution price
aligned_sharp_policy.tradeability: not inferred; PM and sharp staleness remain explicit

cross_clock_policy.next: strictly later event in other clock
cross_clock_policy.previous: strictly earlier event in other clock
cross_clock_policy.threshold_filtering: none in M5; raw lags preserved for M6

limitations: Sharp polling cadence is coarse in H2-v1; nearest cross-clock lags do not imply causal ordering.
Some sharp innovations coincide with exchange-family composition changes.
RN1 fills include same-second clusters and are not assumed statistically independent.
Polymarket response prices are executed prices, not historical bid/ask midpoint observations.
No freshness, magnitude or direction threshold is selected in M5.

m6_feasibility_definitions.broad: direction available; PM baseline <=300s old; response exists; last response <=60s old at target
m6_feasibility_definitions.strict: direction available; PM baseline <=60s old; response exists; last response <=30s old at target

pm_response_policy.missing_response: remains missing, never converted to zero
pm_response_policy.pivot: four horizons become columns on each signal

rn1_clustering_policy.same_second: individual fills retained; cluster size, rank and cluster net HOME exposure preserved
rn1_clustering_policy.same_transaction: individual fills retained; transaction cluster size preserved
rn1_clustering_policy.statistical_interpretation: M6 must account for non-independence rather than treating clustering as additional independent information

sharp_innovation_policy.definition: current sharp HOME consensus probability minus immediately previous sharp HOME consensus probability in same market

unit_of_observation: one RN1 fill or one sharp exchange poll
